test_optimizer_step: test the Optimizer.step method that performs a single optimization step and updates model parameters
test_optimizer_zero_grad: test the Optimizer.zero_grad method that resets the gradients of all optimized tensors to None or zero
test_optimizer_state_dict: test the Optimizer.state_dict method that returns the optimizer state as a serializable dictionary
test_optimizer_load_state_dict: test the Optimizer.load_state_dict method that loads optimizer state from a previously saved dictionary
test_optimizer_add_param_group: test the Optimizer.add_param_group method that adds a new parameter group with optimization options to the optimizer
